backend_source: saved nature-figure preference and existing Python project workflow
core_question: With the same six candidate trajectories, how do R1/R2 change mode ranking, and what does future interaction add beyond the identical generic head?
archetype: quantitative grid and matched trajectory cases

evidence.stage6a_top1fde_comparison: R0/R1/R2 Top1FDE in Overall, Vehicle, Pedestrian and moving vehicle; accompanying paired differences and confidence intervals
evidence.stage6a_oracle_gap: Shared minFDE versus Top1FDE and OracleGap in the three ranking variants; no geometry benefit implied
evidence.stage6a_hit_rate: Probability-selected mode versus GT best-FDE mode, grouped hit rates and paired change intervals
evidence.stage6a_interaction_ablation: Frozen Heterogeneous-20m and VP-context-20m membership, R2-R1 as the controlled interaction contrast
evidence.cases: Four purposive matched examples with the same six candidates, GT, R0/R1/R2 Top1 choices and exact mode probabilities

statistics.interval: paired whole-scene percentile bootstrap, 150 scenes, 1000 resamples, seed2022

review_risks: Oracle metrics must remain exactly shared
Fixed-head variant choice on final VAL is descriptive
Cases are purposive and cannot estimate population benefit
Neighbor interactions are predicted-probability expectations, not observed future collisions
No improvement significance inferred from unpaired bars
